title: Structural Identity
description: Ownership-bearing identity contract that anchors a governed artifact to its origin tenant, repository, and generation. Carried inside every sync envelope. Structural identity is immutable within a generation; a fenced repository transfer starts a new generation and terminates old-tenant applicability. See ADR-0012 (amended) and ADR-0019.

tenantId.description: Tenant scope the repository belongs to. For Personal Node bootstrap, defaults to 'local'.

repositoryId.description: Identifier of the repository, stable across clones. Resolved by the governed identity contract: .amber/identity.json repositoryId override > normalized remote.origin.url > bootstrap default ('local-repository'). Never the repository directory name.

repositoryGeneration.description: Generation counter. Starts at 0. Incremented on fenced repository transfer to a new tenant.

organizationId.description: Organization the tenant belongs to. For Personal Node bootstrap, defaults to 'personal'. Absent means unscoped.

transferRecord.description: Present only after a fenced repository transfer. Proves continuity: historical facts retain their original tenant and generation scope.

amber_protocol_version.description: Amber package version. Inherited from ADR-0012 versioning.
